crop.notes: The three-line Allen notice under 'Sporting Notes', followed by an unrelated story 'THE STEIN BABY DEAD'. Only the first item is about Allen.

ocr.notes: The Allen notice is readable except 'Tom ei' for 'Tom Allen'; the Stein story is mostly right.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's Sporting Notes carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only first-class singers.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, June 6, 1896', page 7. The item is near the bottom of the sixth column.

facts.fact: Allen advertised his place at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, as the 'retired champion pugilist of the world', with a free concert every evening

notes: Paid notice in the Sporting Notes column; the same notice ran on several days in June 1896. Focus is primary for the notice itself, though it is only three lines.
